settings_intro: Every change applies at once and is kept in this browser: after a reload everything stays as you chose it.
settings_theme_hint: Light is the default. “Follow system” tracks your operating system.
settings_theme_lowVision_hint: A theme of its own with higher contrast and larger elements, not just a magnified light one.
settings_motion_hint: One switch governs both animation and sound. Its starting value comes from your system setting.
settings_motion_off_consequence: Motion is off: nothing animates and nothing makes a sound. The sound switch below is unavailable.
settings_sound_hint: Short cues on results and unlocks. Off by default.
settings_sound_blocked: Sound is unavailable while motion is off.
settings_size_hint: From 24 to 40 pixels. The typing line changes at once.
settings_size_preview_text: We are learning to type calmly and accurately.
settings_errors_hint: A mistake always counts, even when you correct it with Backspace.
settings_errors_stopOnLetter_hint: The caret waits until the right character is typed. The default for stage one.
settings_errors_freeBackspace_hint: The caret moves on and you fix a mistake with Backspace.
settings_typing_hint: The map and the exercise catalogue switch to this language. Progress in the other language is kept.
settings_layout_hint: The layout normally follows the typing language, but you can change it on its own.
settings_ui_hint: Independent of the typing language: you can practise Ukrainian with an English interface and the other way round. The exercise text does not change.
settings_ui_current: Right now: interface in {interface}, typing in {typing}.
settings_data_body: All history and progress live only in this browser. Clearing deletes them for good; your settings stay.
settings_data_confirm_body: This cannot be undone. Every attempt, unlocked key and confidence value will be lost.
